correctness.rationale: On the Halmos generic block, the nth power of PQ has row (C^(2n), C^(2n-1)S), so its product with its adjoint is C^(4n-2). The remaining reducing summands contribute zero after subtracting the intersection projection. Spectral min-max for the positive operator C then gives the exact approximation-number power law, from which all stated corollaries follow.

originality.rationale: The classical k=1 norm formula and established product-of-projections singular-value geometry are explicitly excluded. Targeted searches found no source stating the all-k approximation-number identity for arbitrary Hilbert-space pairs or the resulting exact essential-norm and Schatten-index transfer. A broad projection survey not exhaustively inspected remains a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem upgrades a scalar convergence-rate invariant to the complete finite-rank approximation profile, yields compactness and rank rigidity for every iterate, and gives exact Schatten membership renormalization. These consequences distinguish two-projection iteration sharply from general operator powers.
